result.solution_description: Implemented complete Retry-After parsing using only Python’s standard library. Non-negative ASCII integer delta-seconds remain supported, while negative/fractional values are rejected. Strict IMF-fixdate values are parsed and canonically validated, future dates return their delay, past dates clamp to 0.0, and naive `now` values raise ValueError. Added focused tests covering all required behavior and malformed dates.
